entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A Viridian Elf from Mirrodin, once the greatest hunter of the Tangle, later compleated by Vorinclex and serving as his steward.

entities.name: Compleated Glissa
entities.description: The Phyrexian version of Glissa with cable hair, oil-black eyes and a scythe arm, steward of Vorinclex.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who compleated Glissa and treats her as his steward.

entities.name: Chunth
entities.description: A metal-free troll who abducted Glissa to protect her.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: A goblin who helped Glissa and was tortured by Memnarch.

entities.name: Kha Raksha
entities.description: A leonin of Taj-Nar who allied with Glissa.

entities.name: Bosh
entities.description: A golem repaired by Slobad who aided the trio.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: The necromancer ruling Ish-Sah, defeated by Glissa and later a guardian of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Bruenna
entities.description: A Neurok wizard who allied with Glissa against the vedalken.

entities.name: Pontifex
entities.description: The individual orchestrating the attacks in Lumengrid, killed by Glissa.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The golem responsible for the attacks on Mirrodin, who sought Glissa's planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Lyese
entities.description: Glissa's sister, who survived the attack and led the alliance.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A golem who left Glissa, Slobad and Geth as guardians of Mirrodin and the Mirari.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A planeswalker compleated while fighting Glissa in the Hunter Maze.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who encountered Glissa in the Hunter Maze.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Glissa's home plane.

entities.name: The Tangle
entities.description: The forest home of the Viridian elves.

entities.name: Taj-Nar
entities.description: The leonin capital on Mirrodin.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: The vedalken city where Glissa confronted Pontifex.

entities.name: Ish-Sah
entities.description: A structure at the heart of the Mephidross ruled by Geth.

entities.name: Hunter Maze
entities.description: A gladiatorial maze on New Phyrexia that Glissa helped design.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane where Glissa serves.

entities.name: Vicious Swarm
entities.description: Vorinclex's Phyrexian fighting force, much of which Glissa controls.

entities.name: Vanishing
entities.description: The event that pulled away the beings who knew Glissa's good deeds.

entities.name: Fifth Dawn
entities.description: The eruption of the green sun from the core.

events.summary: Trolls abduct Glissa, and Chunth says it was to protect her; she flees and learns the trolls were truthful.
events.quote: This troll called himself Chunth and explained that they had taken her to protect her.

events.summary: Glissa finds her home a charnel house, is wounded and captured by levelers, and is freed by Slobad.
events.quote: she found it a charnel house with levelers milling about.

events.summary: Glissa befriends Kha Raksha at Taj-Nar and travels through the Mephidross with Slobad and Bosh, defeating Geth.
events.quote: After defeating him, she struck a deal to spare him for information

events.summary: In Lumengrid Glissa kills Pontifex, only to have the true culprit revealed.
events.quote: she managed to kill him... only to have the true culprit revealed.

events.summary: Glissa learns Memnarch is responsible, wields the Kaldra artifacts and is betrayed when Memnarch controls the Kaldra Champion; she escapes as the Fifth Dawn erupts.
events.quote: It was revealed that her latent planeswalker's spark was Memnarch's final goal

events.summary: Glissa is arrested for her parents' murder, cleared when levelers attack her trial, and learns her sister Lyese lives.
events.quote: As it turned out, her sister Lyese had not perished during the attack.

events.summary: Glissa is trapped in a time-bubble for five years, then dives to the core and finds Memnarch's spark-transfer machine with a tortured Slobad.
events.quote: she found Slobad strapped to the machine, horribly tortured, and used to engineer it.

events.summary: Glissa knocks Memnarch into the core; her spark transfers to Slobad, who relinquishes it, triggering the Vanishing.
events.quote: Slobad willingly relinquished his newfound spark and powers to save his friend, Glissa

events.summary: Karn leaves Glissa, Slobad and Geth as the new guardians of Mirrodin and the Mirari.
events.quote: Karn left Glissa, Slobad, and Geth as the new guardians of Argentum (Mirrodin) and the Mirari .

events.summary: The elves accuse Glissa of the damage done, calling her Glissa the Traitor; she is eventually corrupted and compleated by Vorinclex.
events.quote: Compleated by Vorinclex , she became the champion of the praetor

events.summary: Glissa becomes Vorinclex's steward and commander of much of the Vicious Swarm, helping design the Hunter Maze.
events.quote: leaving Glissa as his steward to handle long-term matters and other factions.

events.summary: Lukka and Nissa encounter Glissa in the Hunter Maze; Lukka is compleated and joins her against Nissa.
events.quote: Lukka was compleated and joined her in the fight against Nissa.

relations.quote: she now serves as Vorinclex 's steward.

relations.note: She sought to topple his reign.

relations.quote: her sister Lyese had not perished during the attack.

relations.note: He is her friend and traveling companion.
